title: Built-in garage door opener setup and controls
summary: Feedback centers on difficulty pairing, programming, and locating the built-in garage door opener controls, while several other mentions are too vague or refer to unrelated garage contexts.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe failed pairing or programming, inconsistent opener operation, and controls that are hard to locate or use.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention unprogrammed or hard-to-set-up garage openers, requests for larger or illuminated buttons, and some unrelated garage references without clear sentiment.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are undetermined, so the feedback often lacks a clear evaluation of the opener feature.
